personality.description: This person tends to stick to familiar routines, carefully plans ahead, and pays close attention to details, often checking work or decisions more than once. They usually prefer quiet, one-on-one interactions or small groups, and may need time alone to recharge after social demands. When facing moral dilemmas, they first try to protect harmony and avoid hurting others, but their anxiety can make them overthink the consequences and worry about making the wrong choice. In group discussions, they speak cautiously, listen attentively, and choose their words carefully, often softening disagreements and looking for a calm, cooperative path forward.
